relationships.subject: temporomandibular inflammation
relationships.evidence_quote: The results evidenced both short- and long-term alterations on MMP-2 and -9 expression in the limbic structures following CFA-induced temporomandibular inflammation.

key_findings: CFA-induced TMJ inflammation increased gelatinolytic activity in central amygdala, hippocampus, hypothalamus and vlPAG
MMP-2/9 colocalized more with GFAP in central amygdala and vlPAG
